name: True Parallax
description: A reworked, more accurate parallax effect for Rain World that works by warping the entire screen according to level geometry, making the game look slightly zoomed-in and 3-dimensional. This effect is like an advanced form of Parallax Occlusion Mapping.<LINE><LINE>In order to support a variety of devices and player preferences, this mod has been made highly configurable. Please check out the remix/config menu for this mod and browse through the handful of available presets. Or if you're feeling adventurous, try fiddling with some of the settings and make your own preset!<LINE><LINE>If you are experiencing low framerates, you should probably disable this mod.<LINE><LINE>Mod compatibility:<LINE>* SBCameraScroll: This mod has been specifically designed for compatibility with SBCameraScroll. Unfortunately, SBCameraScroll's experimental zoom feature has some shader bugs I can't fix.<LINE>* Camera Scroll Fix: Highly recommended for use with this mod! Camera Scroll Fix removes the seams in the room, and this mod adds depth to it.<LINE>* Sharpener: Sharpener causes absolutely no issues. And because this mod zooms in the camera slightly, I recommend using Sharpener!<LINE>* Stick Together Co-op + SBCameraScroll: The dynamic zoom-out feature of Stick Together Co-op does technically work with this mod, but it just looks terrible with parallax, so I do not recommend it.<LINE>* Split-screen Co-op: For the most part, NOT compatible. The parallax works for the first camera only, and it is automatically disabled for any other cameras. So having this mod active hopefully shouldn't cause any issues, because its designed to disable itself for split-screen.
